sources.label: Wikipedia, "Tau Boötis"
sources.quote: Tau Boötis, Latinised from τ Boötis and formally named Tepiamenit, is a wide binary star system in the northern constellation of Boötes.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.5 solar radii and 1.25 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,319 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
